{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write them one per line to /app/solution.txt.","required_artifacts":["/app/solution.txt","downloaded local copy of the referenced video or equivalent inspectable media artifact"],"required_behaviors":["Acquire the referenced video content from the provided URL.","Extract the complete ordered sequence of moves entered by the player from the video content.","Write exactly one move per line in /app/solution.txt using the move text as shown/entered in the video."],"known_invalid_patterns":["Guessing or inventing moves without evidence from the video.","Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient evidence.","Using only partial transcript or partial move list."],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace and tool availability.","Download or otherwise obtain an inspectable local copy of the referenced video.","Extract the move sequence from the video content with evidence.","Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence."],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/inspectable video artifact.","Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted complete move list.","Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the same complete move list, one per line."],"notes":["Need to preserve original request and avoid surrogate success criteria."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -e
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '\nFILES:\n'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '\nTOOLS:\n'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)" || echo "$t=missing"; done","timeout":120000}]}

set -e
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '
FILES:
'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
printf '
TOOLS:
'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget jq; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)" || echo "$t=missing"; done
